learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to automatic control theory and its application.

syllabus_topics: Control aims, feedforward control, feedback control, simple control circuit
Stability of dynamic system, quality criteria
State-space description of dynamic system, controller, observer
Digital control, digital PID controller, Z-transform
assessment_rules: Attending lectures and seminars is required, followed by an examination in the form of an oral and written test.
bibliography: DORF, R.C., BISHOP, R.H. Modern Control Systems, Addison - Wesley, Berkeley, 1998.
LUYBEN, W.L. Process Modeling, Simulation and Control for chemical engineers, McGraw-Hill, New York, 1973.
degree: Bachelor's programme, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics - courses in English
